text: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
◈ Something in Arnold's eyes has changed. They've seen enough out there to stop being afraid of the dark.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
